about.label: About Us
about.body: For over 20 years, Smart Alliance has delivered custom software development and system integration solutions for government agencies and enterprise organizations. We help clients design, develop, integrate, and maintain digital systems that improve efficiency, streamline operations, and support long-term growth.

partnership.heading: Technology Partnerships
partnership.body: Smart Alliance partners with leading global technology providers to deliver enterprise-grade digital solutions. As an Authorized Axway Partner, we provide expertise in API Management, Managed File Transfer (MFT), B2B Integration, and enterprise integration platforms.

intro.label: Get to know Smart Alliance
intro.body: Founded in 2004, we set out to become a leading provider of IT projects for the public and private sectors. Our ISO/IEC 29110-4-1:2018 certification in software engineering means our work meets internationally recognized standards. Our team is carefully selected and trained by the product vendors themselves, so every engagement runs as smoothly as possible, and our track record has earned the trust of many leading organizations.

custom.title: Custom Software Development
custom.body: We design and build software around your organization's requirements, supporting your policies and specialized processes to raise efficiency and elevate how you work.
custom.overview: We design and develop software that fits each organization's needs — web applications and mobile applications alike — with full support for paperless operations. We cover the whole lifecycle: analysis, design, development, testing, and go-live, followed by maintenance and further development, so your organization runs efficiently, securely, and in line with government policy and international standards.

features: API gateway design and usage control
api.overview: We design and build APIs and connect your systems with government agencies, business partners, and the legacy platforms you already run, so data flows continuously, accurately, and securely. As an Axway partner, we set up API Management and Managed File Transfer (MFT) that is governed centrally, fully auditable, and ready to scale with your digital services.

workflow.title: Digital Workflow & e-⁠Services
workflow.body: We deliver paperless solutions spanning workflow automation, electronic documents, and digital platforms to improve your processes and the services you provide to citizens.
workflow.overview: We build digital workflow systems that take paper processes online end to end — submitting requests, reviewing and approving them, tracking their status, and storing the electronic documents. The result is shorter turnaround, lower costs, and more transparency, in line with the Electronic Transactions Act, so your organization can serve citizens and partners more conveniently.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.paragraph: How Smart Alliance collects, uses and protects your personal data, and the rights you have under the Personal Data Protection Act B.E. 2562 (2019).

sections.heading: Who we are
paragraphs: Smart Alliance Co., Ltd. (“Smart Alliance”, “we”, “us”) is the data controller for personal data collected through www.smartalliance.co.th (the “Website”). This policy explains what we collect, why, how long we keep it and the rights you have under the Personal Data Protection Act B.E. 2562 (2019) (the “PDPA”).

sections.heading: Personal data we collect
paragraphs: We collect only what you give us, or what is needed to run the Website securely:
items: Contact form: your name and email address and, if you choose to provide them, your company or organization, phone number, subject and message.
Consent record: that you agreed to this policy and to the Terms and Conditions, and when.
Technical data: your IP address and basic request details such as browser type and the time of the request, used to protect the contact form against abuse and kept in server logs.
Language preference: a cookie that remembers whether you chose the English or the Thai version of the Website.
Cookie notice: a cookie that remembers that you accepted the cookie notice, so it is not shown again on every page. It expires after one day.

sections.heading: How we use it
paragraphs: We use your personal data to:
We do not sell your personal data, and we do not use it for marketing without asking you first.
items: reply to your enquiry and provide the information, quotation or service you asked about (steps taken at your request before entering into a contract, or performance of a contract);
keep a record of our correspondence with you (legitimate interest);
protect the Website and the contact form against spam, fraud and abuse (legitimate interest);
comply with legal obligations that apply to us.

sections.heading: Spam protection (Google reCAPTCHA)
paragraphs: The contact form is protected by Google reCAPTCHA. To tell people from automated programs, reCAPTCHA collects hardware and software information, such as device and application data, and sends it to Google for analysis. That information is governed by Google's Privacy Policy and Terms of Service, published at policies.google.com.

sections.heading: Who we share it with
paragraphs: Your personal data is handled by the members of our team who need it to respond to you. We also rely on service providers that process data on our behalf:
We may also disclose personal data where the law requires it, for example to a government authority or a court.
items: Microsoft (Microsoft 365), which hosts the mailbox that receives contact form submissions;
our hosting provider, which runs the servers the Website is served from.

sections.heading: Transfers outside Thailand
paragraphs: Some of these providers store or process data outside Thailand. Where they do, we rely on their contractual safeguards and data protection standards, as the PDPA permits.

sections.heading: How long we keep it
paragraphs: We keep contact form submissions and our correspondence for as long as we need them to respond to you and to manage any business relationship that follows, and for no longer than 2 years after our last contact with you unless the law requires us to keep them longer. Server logs are kept for no longer than 90 days.

sections.heading: Your rights
paragraphs: Under the PDPA you have the right to:
To exercise any of these rights, contact us using the details below. We will respond within 30 days.
items: withdraw your consent at any time, without affecting processing that took place before you withdrew it;
request access to, and a copy of, your personal data;
ask us to correct personal data that is inaccurate, out of date or incomplete;
ask us to delete, destroy or anonymize your personal data;
ask us to restrict, or object to, the processing of your personal data;
receive your personal data in a commonly used electronic format, or have it sent to another data controller;
lodge a complaint with the Personal Data Protection Committee.

sections.heading: Security
paragraphs: We use appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect personal data, including encrypted connections (HTTPS) and restricted access to the mailbox that receives enquiries.

sections.heading: Changes to this policy
paragraphs: We may update this policy from time to time. The effective date at the top of this page shows when it last changed.

terms.title: Terms and Conditions
terms.paragraph: The terms that apply when you use the Smart Alliance website.

sections.heading: Acceptance of these terms
paragraphs: By using www.smartalliance.co.th (the “Website”), operated by Smart Alliance Co., Ltd. (“Smart Alliance”, “we”, “us”), you agree to these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree, please do not use the Website.

sections.heading: Use of the Website
paragraphs: You agree to use the Website lawfully, and not to:
items: attempt to gain unauthorized access to the Website, its servers or any related system;
interfere with the Website's operation, including by sending automated or bulk requests;
submit false, misleading, unlawful or harmful content through the contact form;
use the Website to send spam or unsolicited advertising.

sections.heading: Information on the Website
paragraphs: The content of the Website is general information about Smart Alliance and our services. We make reasonable efforts to keep it accurate and up to date, but it is not an offer, a quotation or professional advice. Any engagement is governed by a separate written agreement.

sections.heading: Intellectual property
paragraphs: The Website and its content, including text, graphics, logos and images, belong to Smart Alliance or to our licensors and are protected by law. Third-party trademarks, including Axway, belong to their respective owners. You may view and print pages for your own reference, but you may not copy, modify or distribute the content without our written permission.

sections.heading: Contact form submissions
paragraphs: When you send us a message through the contact form, you confirm that the information you provide is accurate and that you are entitled to share it. Please do not send confidential information or passwords through the form. We handle the personal data in your message as described in our Privacy Policy.

sections.heading: Links to other websites
paragraphs: The Website may link to websites run by others, such as our technology partners or Google Maps. We do not control those websites and are not responsible for their content or their privacy practices.

sections.heading: Limitation of liability
paragraphs: The Website is provided “as is”. To the extent the law permits, Smart Alliance is not liable for any loss or damage arising from your use of, or inability to use, the Website, or from reliance on its content.

sections.heading: Changes to these terms
paragraphs: We may update these Terms and Conditions from time to time. If you continue to use the Website after a change, you accept the updated terms.

sections.heading: Governing law
paragraphs: These Terms and Conditions are governed by the laws of Thailand, and the courts of Thailand have jurisdiction over any dispute arising from them.
